A year is one trip around the Sun, and every planet takes a different time. At 30 Earth years you would be about 124 on Mercury, 16 on Mars and just 1 on Saturn, and you would only reach your first Neptune birthday at 164.

Source:
NASA NSSDCA Planetary Fact Sheet (orbital periods): https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/factsheet/

Images: NASA / JPL / Space Science Institute (Saturn, Cassini), NASA / JHUAPL / Carnegie (Mercury, MESSENGER, enhanced colour), NASA / JPL / USGS (Mars, Viking), NASA / JPL (Neptune, Voyager). Narration uses a synthetic voice.
